name: Vertex Addons for Elementor
author: Webilia Inc.

sections.description:
Vertex Addons For Elementor Builder is designed to enhance your page-building experience like never before. It provides a diverse range of powerful and feature-packed widgets that integrate seamlessly with Elementor. Whether you’re building a complex website or a simple landing page, Vertex offers all the tools you need to create stunning web designs without writing a single line of code.

✅ Demo
✅ Documentation
✅ Support
✅ Live Chat

Key Features

  • +38 Essential Free Widgets: A comprehensive collection of versatile and customizable widgets, including News Ticker, Testimonial Carousel, Countdown, and more.
  • Custom Extensions: Extend Elementor’s capabilities with advanced features like Wrapper Link, Scroll to Top, Sticky and Custom CSS/JS.
  • Responsive & User-Friendly: Ensure that your website looks great on all devices with fully responsive designs.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Built with performance in mind, Vertex Addons ensures your website stays fast without unnecessary bloat.
  • Highly Customizable: Fine-tune the appearance and behavior of each widget with advanced styling and layout options.
  • News Ticker Widget: Display dynamic news feeds and updates.
  • Accordion Widget: Organize your content with collapsible sections.
  • Testimonial Carousel Widget: Showcase customer feedback and reviews in style.
  • Countdown Widget: Build excitement for upcoming events.
  • Fancy Text Widget: Add engaging typography effects.
  • Search Input Widget: Enhance navigation with a custom search bar.
  • Login, Register Widget: Create amazing and attractive login or registration forms.

Free Extensions

  • Custom CSS/JS: Easily add custom CSS or JavaScript to extend functionality.
  • Wrapper Link: Wrap entire sections or widgets in clickable links.
  • Scroll to Top: Add a smooth scroll-to-top button to improve user experience.
  • Sticky: Create eye-catching sticky element effects.

Free Other Features

  • Templates Kit Demo Importer
  • Dynamic Tags (Post Title, Post Excerpt, Post Content, Post Date, Internal Link, etc)
  • Advanced Popup Builder
  • Advanced Template Builder (Header, Footer, Archive, Dynamic loop Item And Single Template)

What’s Needed?

  1. Elementor Free Version: You’ll need the free version of Elementor to use this plugin.
  2. Vertex Addons Free Version: Download and activate the Vertex Addons plugin.
    The Vertex Addons plugin is regularly updated to ensure compatibility with the latest version of WordPress and Elementor, keeping your website secure and up-to-date with new features.

Why Choose Vertex Addons for Elementor Builder?

Vertex Addons provides an all-in-one solution for web designers looking to push Elementor’s design capabilities further. By adding these carefully crafted widgets, you save time while creating a more dynamic and visually stunning website.
* User-Friendly: Designed with simplicity and usability in mind, even beginners can quickly learn to use the Vertex Addons.
* Seamless Integration: Works flawlessly with Elementor’s drag-and-drop editor.
* Customizable: All widgets come with rich styling and customization options.
* Support & Documentation: We offer detailed documentation and friendly support to help you every step of the way.

Support

If you run into any issues, please don’t hesitate to reach out to our support team. We are here to help you!

Documentation

Want to dive deeper into how each widget works? Check out Vertex documentation to learn about every feature and customization option available in the Vertex Addons.
sections.installation:
• Upload the vertex-addons.zip file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  • Navigate to Elementor > Vertex Addons to explore all widgets.
sections.faq:
Is Vertex Addons compatible with Elementor Pro?

Yes, Vertex works seamlessly with both Elementor Free and Pro versions.

How can I get support?

You can reach our support team at Vertex Support or check our documentation for help.

Can I use these widgets with other page builders?

Currently, Vertex Addons is designed for Elementor, but we plan to expand to other page builders in the future.
